The '''Extorin Major system''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Extorin sector/Legends|Extorin sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Extorin Major system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square J-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
